title: Tune without restarting
description: Start from the fixed controller in 4.1. Read speed on every timer callback so ros2 param set changes robot motion without restarting the node.
steps: Declare speed with default 0.2 on /student_controller.
Replace the fixed command with a current parameter read in each timer callback; clamp it to 0–0.8.
While the node keeps running, set /student_controller speed to 0.6 from a terminal. Observe the speed change without a restart.
hints: A parameter belongs to the node, not to /cmd_vel.
Reading once at startup will not apply a later ros2 param set.
Keep the timer running and read get_parameter("speed").value inside tick.

nl.title: Bijregelen zonder herschrijven
nl.description: Begin met de vaste controller uit 4.1. Lees speed bij elke timer-callback, zodat ros2 param set de robot zonder herstart sneller laat rijden.
steps: Declareer speed met standaardwaarde 0.2 op /student_controller.
Vervang de vaste opdracht door een actuele parameterlezing in elke timer-callback; begrens tot 0–0.8.
Zet speed tijdens het draaien via een terminal op 0.6. Bekijk de snelheidsverandering zonder herstart.
hints: De parameter hoort bij de node, niet bij /cmd_vel.
Eén keer bij het starten lezen past latere wijzigingen niet toe.
Laat de timer draaien en lees get_parameter("speed").value in tick.

fr.title: Ajuster sans réécrire
fr.description: Reprenez le contrôleur fixe de 4.1. Lisez speed à chaque callback du timer pour que ros2 param set change le mouvement sans redémarrer le nœud.
steps: Déclarez speed avec la valeur par défaut 0.2 sur /student_controller.
Remplacez la commande fixe par une lecture du paramètre à chaque callback ; limitez-la à 0–0.8.
Pendant que le nœud tourne, réglez speed à 0.6 dans un terminal. Observez le changement sans redémarrage.
hints: Le paramètre appartient au nœud, pas à /cmd_vel.
Une lecture au démarrage ne prend pas en compte les changements ultérieurs.
Laissez le timer actif et lisez get_parameter("speed").value dans tick.

es.title: Ajustar sin reiniciar
es.description: Parte del controlador fijo de 4.1. Lee speed en cada callback del temporizador para que ros2 param set cambie el movimiento sin reiniciar el nodo.
steps: Declara speed con valor inicial 0.2 en /student_controller.
Sustituye la orden fija por la lectura actual del parámetro en cada callback; limita a 0–0.8.
Mientras el nodo sigue activo, establece speed en 0.6 desde un terminal. Observa el cambio sin reiniciar.
hints: El parámetro pertenece al nodo, no a /cmd_vel.
Leerlo una vez al inicio no aplica cambios posteriores.
Mantén el temporizador activo y lee get_parameter("speed").value dentro de tick.

de.title: Ohne Neustart anpassen
de.description: Beginne mit dem festen Controller aus 4.1. Lies speed bei jedem Timer-Callback, damit ros2 param set die Bewegung ohne Neustart ändert.
steps: Deklariere speed mit Standardwert 0.2 auf /student_controller.
Ersetze den festen Befehl durch den aktuellen Parameterwert in jedem Callback; begrenze auf 0–0.8.
Setze speed bei laufendem Knoten im Terminal auf 0.6. Beobachte die Änderung ohne Neustart.
hints: Der Parameter gehört zum Knoten, nicht zu /cmd_vel.
Einmaliges Lesen beim Start übernimmt spätere Änderungen nicht.
Lass den Timer laufen und lies get_parameter("speed").value in tick.

pt.title: Ajustar sem reiniciar
pt.description: Parte do controlador fixo de 4.1. Lê speed em cada callback do temporizador para que ros2 param set altere o movimento sem reiniciar o nó.
steps: Declara speed com valor inicial 0.2 em /student_controller.
Troca o comando fixo pela leitura atual do parâmetro em cada callback; limita a 0–0.8.
Com o nó a funcionar, define speed como 0.6 no terminal. Observa a mudança sem reiniciar.
hints: O parâmetro pertence ao nó, não a /cmd_vel.
Ler uma vez no início não aplica alterações posteriores.
Mantém o temporizador ativo e lê get_parameter("speed").value em tick.

it.title: Regolare senza riavviare
it.description: Parti dal controllore a velocità fissa di 4.1. Leggi speed a ogni callback del timer, così ros2 param set cambia il movimento senza riavviare il nodo.
steps: Dichiara speed con valore iniziale 0.2 su /student_controller.
Sostituisci il comando fisso con la lettura attuale del parametro a ogni callback; limita a 0–0.8.
Mentre il nodo è attivo, imposta speed a 0.6 dal terminale. Osserva il cambiamento senza riavvio.
hints: Il parametro appartiene al nodo, non a /cmd_vel.
Leggerlo solo all’avvio non applica modifiche successive.
Lascia attivo il timer e leggi get_parameter("speed").value in tick.

python.starterCode:
import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from geometry_msgs.msg import Twist

rclpy.init()
node = Node('student_controller')
node.declare_parameter('speed', 0.2)
publisher = node.create_publisher(Twist, '/cmd_vel', 10)
def tick():
    command = Twist()
    # TODO: replace this fixed speed with the current speed parameter.
    command.linear.x = 0.2
    publisher.publish(command)
node.create_timer(0.2, tick)
rclpy.spin(node)

content.title: Tune without restarting
content.description: Start from the fixed controller in 4.1. Read speed on every timer callback so ros2 param set changes robot motion without restarting the node. Native ROS 2 distinguishes integer and double parameters.
steps: Declare speed with default 0.2 on /student_controller.
Replace the fixed command with a current parameter read in each timer callback; clamp it to 0–0.8.
While the node keeps running, set /student_controller speed to 0.6 from a terminal. Observe the speed change without a restart.
hints: The parameter belongs to /student_controller, not /cmd_vel.
Read get_parameter("speed").as_double() inside the timer, then clamp to 0.0–0.8.
Keep the node running while ros2 param set changes its behavior.
